clue.text: This docket banning party inside clumps of dense vegetation

indicators.note: inside means what is left of the docket sits within the letters of This

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: banning means the word for the party is shut out of the docket

parts.note: taken as written
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: Someone pointing at an official docket that seems to outlaw celebrations within some patch of undergrowth.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'party' as a political group; it is just a do, and 'banning' leaves CKET to go 'inside' the word This.
explanation.definitionFit: A thicket is a dense growth of shrubs or small trees, so a group of them are clumps of undergrowth.

clue.text: Killer longing to intervene between Hungary and Austria

indicators.note: to intervene between means the longing word goes into the gap separating the two country codes

parts.note: H is the international vehicle code for Hungary
A is the international vehicle code for Austria
a yen is a longing or craving

explanation.surface: A murderer whose desire to step into a dispute between two Central European nations sounds like diplomacy gone wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: The hyena is a predator that hunts and kills its prey, so it can be called a killer.

clue.text: Flyer's hand baggage announcement beginning to cause argument

indicators.note: an announcement is something spoken out, so the baggage word is heard rather than seen

parts.note: carry-on luggage is hand baggage taken into an aircraft cabin

indicators.note: beginning to means the opening letter of cause is taken

parts.note: a row is a noisy argument

explanation.surface: An airline passenger's cabin bag is announced, and that starts a quarrel at the gate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flyer' sits naturally with the aviation picture but is the definition: a bird, not a passenger.
explanation.definitionFit: The carrion crow is a common black bird, and birds are flyers.

clue.text: Skilfully clearing lobby after getting 10p to stop plane possibly going up

indicators.note: after means the cleared lobby comes at the end, following the rest
to stop means the ten-pence letters plug a gap in the upturned tree
going up in a down entry means the tree word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the plane is a kind of tree, so a tree is a possible plane
X is the Roman numeral ten and P is penny

indicators.note: clearing means the inside of lobby is emptied, leaving its outside letters

explanation.surface: Someone deftly emptying an airport lobby after paying ten pence to halt an aircraft taking off.
explanation.walkthrough: The plane is the tree, not an aircraft: 'going up' gives EERT, which 'to stop' opens for the ten pence; 'clearing' keeps only the ends of lobby.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in the manner of an expert is doing it with skill, an adverb matching skilfully.

clue.text: Theologian arranging to quash Satanism

indicators.note: arranging means the letters of to quash Satanism are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A churchman sets out to crush devil worship.
explanation.definitionFit: The thirteenth-century Dominican friar wrote the Summa Theologica and is among the most famous Christian theologians.

clue.text: Russian ready to prepare for firing during exercise? Just the opposite!

Just the opposite flips the containment, so the exercise goes inside the firing word

parts.note: to cock a gun is to raise its hammer ready for firing
PE is physical education, i.e. exercise

explanation.surface: A Russian soldier gets ready to fire during a drill, or rather the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ready' is old British slang for cash (as in 'ready money'), so 'Russian ready' is a Russian coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The copeck, a hundredth of a rouble, is Russian money; ready is slang for cash.

clue.text: Believe adaptation will give support to King Charles

an edit is a reworked version, an adaptation of a text or film

explanation.definitionFit: To credit a story is to believe it or accept it as true.

clue.text: Read supreme organisation eliminated millions

indicators.note: organisation means the letters of supreme are reorganised
eliminated means the letter for millions is taken out of the pool

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.walkthrough: Take M out of SUPREME to leave SUPREE, which 'organisation' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read something through, often carefully; both are verbs.

clue.text: Left-winger working to replace street service

on means working, as in a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A socialist off to work taking the place of a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Holy Communion is the Christian Eucharist, a church service.

clue.text: Go to town in ramshackle triplane

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Flying off to the city in a rickety three-winged aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ramshackle' looks like an anagram signal for triplane, but the answer simply sits inside the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are idioms for acting without restraint and throwing yourself fully into something.

clue.text: Mothers worried about energy come to logical conclusions

worried means the letters of Mothers are disturbed into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' turns MOTHERS into THEORMS, and 'about' wraps that round E.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics, a proposition proved by reasoning from axioms is reached as a logical conclusion.

clue.text: Large quantity of money I found in dry stream bed

parts.note: a wad is a thick bundle of banknotes

explanation.surface: A treasure-hunter stumbles on a stash of cash lying in a dried-up creek.
explanation.definitionFit: In North Africa and Arabia, a riverbed that holds water only after rain is called by this Arabic term.

clue.text: Eradicating disease later than one of Pooh's friends can

indicators.note: later than means the disease word comes after the others

parts.note: Roo is the young kangaroo among Winnie-the-Pooh's friends
a tin is a can
gout is a painful joint disease

explanation.surface: A disease being wiped out after a children's-book character gets a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: To root something out is to pull it up by the roots, so to destroy it completely.

clue.text: Venomous lizard constructed in smart Lego

indicators.note: constructed means the letters of in smart Lego are built into a new shape

explanation.surface: A poisonous reptile modelled from fancy plastic building bricks.
explanation.definitionFit: This large lizard of the American Southwest is one of very few venomous lizards.

clue.text: Tree almost got animal agitated

indicators.note: agitated means the combined letters are stirred into a new order
almost means the last letter of got is dropped

parts.note: taken as written before trimming
taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims GOT to GO; 'agitated' then rearranges GO plus ANIMAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The magnolia is a flowering tree or shrub with large showy blooms.

clue.text: Range of Italy's active writer figures

parts.note: A is the grammatical abbreviation for active

clue.text: Woman heads for Luton's only intelligent solicitor

explanation.definitionFit: It is a female given name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Saying piece of gymnastic apparatus is something found in the woodshed

clue.text: Leading couples in West Iran get a flow regulator

clue.text: The way the Marines slosh gin around is quite scary

around reinforces that the letters of gin are moved round

clue.text: Maps covering India's wide open spaces

parts.note: plans are maps or diagrams
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

clue.text: Machinery for clearing roads immediately power is supplied in Berkshire town

clue.text: Stick to stopping Prohibition
